intro.en: Two friends meet at the hospital. One has a toothache and the other an earache. Learn to ask «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» (what do you feel?) and to name parts of the body.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke do dost hospital mein milte hain. Ek ke daant mein dard hai aur doosre ke kaan mein. Hum poochna seekhenge «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» (aap ko kya mehsoos ho raha hai?) aur jism ke hisson ke naam.
intro.ar: يَلْتَقي صَديقانِ في المُسْتَشْفى: أَحَدُهُما يَشْكو مِنْ أَلَمٍ في أَسْنانِهِ وَالآخَرُ في أُذُنِهِ. تَعَلَّمْ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» وَأَسْماءَ أَعْضاءِ الجِسْمِ.

dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh
dialogue.en: Peace, mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati, Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hon.

dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salāmu wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace, mercy and blessings of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap par bhi salamati, Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hon.

dialogue.en: Why did you come to the hospital today?
dialogue.ur: Aap aaj hospital kyun aaye?

dialogue.en: I came to visit the dentist.
dialogue.ur: Main daanton ke doctor se milne aaya hoon.

dialogue.en: What do you feel?
dialogue.ur: Aap ko kya mehsoos ho raha hai?

dialogue.ar: أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أَسْنانِي. وَلِماذا حَضَرْتَ أَنْتَ إلى المُسْتَشْفى؟
dialogue.tr: ashʿuru bi-alamin shadīdin fī asnānī. wa li-mādhā ḥaḍarta anta ilā l-mustashfā?
dialogue.en: I feel a severe pain in my teeth. And why did you come?
dialogue.ur: Mere daanton mein bohat tez dard hai. Aur aap kyun aaye?

dialogue.ar: حَضَرْتُ لِزِيارَةِ طَبيبِ الأَنْفِ وَالأُذُنِ وَالحَنْجَرَة.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍartu li-ziyārati ṭabībi l-anfi wal-udhuni wal-ḥanjarah
dialogue.en: I came to visit the nose, ear and throat doctor.
dialogue.ur: Main naak, kaan aur gale ke doctor se milne aaya hoon.

dialogue.en: What do you feel?
dialogue.ur: Aap ko kya mehsoos ho raha hai?

dialogue.en: I feel a severe pain in my ear.
dialogue.ur: Mere kaan mein bohat tez dard hai.

dialogue.en: Do you have an appointment with the doctor?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ka doctor se waqt (appointment) liya hua hai?

dialogue.en: Yes, my appointment is at ten o'clock.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mera waqt dus baje ka hai.

dialogue.en: My appointment is at ten o'clock too.
dialogue.ur: Mera waqt bhi dus baje ka hai.

dialogue.ar: السّاعَةُ الآنَ التّاسِعَةُ وَالنِّصْف، الباقي نِصْفُ ساعَة.
dialogue.tr: as-sāʿatu l-āna t-tāsiʿatu wan-niṣf, al-bāqī niṣfu sāʿah
dialogue.en: It is now half past nine; half an hour remains.
dialogue.ur: Abhi saade nau baje hain, aadha ghanta baaqi hai.

q.en: How do you ask «What do you feel?»
q.ur: «Aap ko kya mehsoos ho raha hai?» Arabi mein kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ مَريضًا عَمّا يَشْعُرُ بِهِ؟

q.en: Masood says «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني». What is hurting?
q.ur: Masood kehta hai «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني». Kya dard kar raha hai?
q.ar: يَقولُ مَسْعودٌ: «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني». ما الَّذي يُؤْلِمُهُ؟

options_ar: أَعْضاءٌ في الفَمِ نَمْضَغُ بِها الطَّعامَ

intro.en: A student was absent from school because of a bad cold. His teacher asks what happened, and the student tells about his headache, the ambulance and the doctor's advice.
intro.ur: Ek talib-e-ilm school nahi aaya kyunke usay sakht zukam ho gaya tha. Ustaad poochte hain kya hua, aur wo sar dard, ambulance aur doctor ki naseehat batata hai.
intro.ar: غابَ طالِبٌ عَنِ المَدْرَسَةِ بِسَبَبِ زُكامٍ شَديدٍ. يَسْأَلُهُ المُعَلِّمُ عَمّا حَدَثَ، فَيَحْكي عَنِ الصُّداعِ وَالإِسْعافِ وَنَصيحَةِ الطَّبيبِ.

dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh
dialogue.en: Peace, mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati, Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hon.

dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salāmu wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace, mercy and blessings of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap par bhi salamati, Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hon.

dialogue.en: Why were you absent from class?
dialogue.ur: Aap padhai se gair-hazir kyun rahe?

dialogue.en: I caught a bad cold.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe sakht zukam ho gaya tha.

dialogue.en: What did you feel?
dialogue.ur: Aap ne kya mehsoos kiya?

dialogue.ar: شَعَرْتُ بِصُداعٍ شَديدٍ في اللَّيْل، وَارْتَفَعَتْ دَرَجَةُ حَرارَتي.
dialogue.tr: shaʿartu bi-ṣudāʿin shadīdin fī l-layl, wartafaʿat darajatu ḥarāratī
dialogue.en: I felt a bad headache at night, and my temperature went up.
dialogue.ur: Raat ko mujhe sakht sar dard hua aur mera bukhar (hararat) charh gaya.

dialogue.en: Did you meet the doctor?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap doctor se mile?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، ذَهَبْتُ إلى المُسْتَشْفى بِالإِسْعاف، وَقابَلْتُ الطَّبيب.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, dhahabtu ilā l-mustashfā bil-isʿāf, wa qābaltu ṭ-ṭabīb
dialogue.en: Yes, I went to the hospital by ambulance and met the doctor.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, main ambulance se hospital gaya aur doctor se mila.

dialogue.en: And what did the doctor advise you?
dialogue.ur: Aur doctor ne aap ko kya naseehat ki?

dialogue.ar: نَصَحَني بِالرّاحَةِ وَتَناوُلِ الدَّواء، وَهذا هُوَ التَّقْريرُ الطِّبِّيّ.
dialogue.tr: naṣaḥanī bir-rāḥati wa tanāwuli d-dawāʾ, wa hādhā huwa t-taqrīru ṭ-ṭibbī
dialogue.en: He advised me to rest and take medicine, and this is the medical report.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne aaraam aur dawa lene ki naseehat ki, aur ye raha medical report.

dialogue.tr: shukran lak. wa bima tashʿuru l-ān?
dialogue.en: Thank you. And what do you feel now?
dialogue.ur: Shukriya. Aur ab aap ko kaisa lag raha hai?

dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, I am fine.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, main theek hoon.

vocab.ur: wo beemar ya zakhmi hota hai

options: rest and medicine / aaraam aur dawa

intro.en: A wife asks her husband about his visit to the doctor. Learn about the heart, blood pressure and healthy food, and how to wish someone well: «شَفاكَ الله».
intro.ur: Biwi apne shauhar se doctor ke paas jane ke bare mein poochti hai. Hum dil, blood pressure aur sehat mand khane ke bare mein seekhenge, aur dua dena: «شَفاكَ الله» (Allah aap ko shifa de).
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ زَوْجَةٌ زَوْجَها عَنْ زِيارَتِهِ لِلطَّبيبِ. تَعَلَّمْ عَنِ القَلْبِ وَضَغْطِ الدَّمِ وَالطَّعامِ الصِّحِّيِّ، وَكَيْفَ تَدْعو لِمَريضٍ: «شَفاكَ اللهُ».

dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh
dialogue.en: Peace, mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati, Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hon.

dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salāmu wa raḥmatu llāhi wa barakātuh
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace, mercy and blessings of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap par bhi salamati, Allah ki rehmat aur barkatein hon.

dialogue.en: All good, I hope. Did you meet the doctor?
dialogue.ur: Khair to hai? Kya aap doctor se mile?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، وَفَحَصَ الصَّدْرَ وَالقَلْبَ وَالكُلْيَة، وَقاسَ الضَّغْط.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa faḥaṣa ṣ-ṣadra wal-qalba wal-kulyah, wa qāsa ḍ-ḍaghṭ
dialogue.en: Yes, he examined the chest, heart and kidney, and measured the blood pressure.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, unhon ne seena, dil aur gurde ka muaina kiya aur blood pressure napa.

dialogue.en: And what was the result?
dialogue.ur: Aur nateeja kya raha?

dialogue.ar: القَلْبُ سَليم، وَالحَمْدُ لِله. هُناكَ ارْتِفاعٌ قَليلٌ في الضَّغْطِ وَالسُّكَّرِيّ.
dialogue.tr: al-qalbu salīm, wal-ḥamdu lillāh. hunāka irtifāʿun qalīlun fī ḍ-ḍaghṭi was-sukkarī
dialogue.en: The heart is healthy, praise be to Allah. There is a slight rise in blood pressure and sugar.
dialogue.ur: Dil theek hai, Alhamdulillah. Blood pressure aur sugar thora sa barha hua hai.

dialogue.en: What is the reason for that?
dialogue.ur: Iski wajah kya hai?

dialogue.en: Gaining weight.
dialogue.ur: Wazan ka barh jana.

dialogue.en: And what did the doctor ask of you?
dialogue.ur: Aur doctor ne aap se kya kaha?

dialogue.en: He asked me to give up sweets.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne mujh se meethi cheezein chhodne ko kaha.

dialogue.tr: wa hal ṭalaba minka shayʾan ākhar?
dialogue.en: Did he ask you for anything else?
dialogue.ur: Kya unhon ne kuch aur bhi kaha?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، مُمارَسَةَ الرِّياضَة، وَتَناوُلَ الفَواكِهِ وَالخُضْراوات.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, mumārasata r-riyāḍah, wa tanāwula l-fawākihi wal-khuḍrāwāt
dialogue.en: Yes: to do sport and eat fruits and vegetables.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan: warzish karna aur phal aur sabziyan khana.

dialogue.en: May Allah heal you.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko shifa de.

dialogue.en: Ameen, thank you.
dialogue.ur: Ameen, shukriya.

q.en: What does the wife say to wish him well?
q.ur: Biwi dua dene ke liye kya kehti hai?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ الزَّوْجَةُ لِتَدْعُوَ لَهُ بِالشِّفاءِ؟

q.en: What does the doctor ask him to give up?
q.ur: Doctor ne kya chhodne ko kaha?
q.ar: ماذا يَطْلُبُ الطَّبيبُ مِنْهُ أَنْ يَتْرُكَ؟

intro.en: Here you learn the tens: twenty, thirty, forty … up to a hundred and a thousand. There are also matching practice slides for body parts.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum dahaiyan seekhenge: bees, tees, chalees… sau aur hazaar tak. Saath mein jism ke hisson ko tasweer se milane ki mashq bhi hai.
intro.ar: هُنا تَتَعَلَّمُ العُقودَ: عِشْرون، ثَلاثون، أَرْبَعون … إِلى مِئَةٍ وَأَلْفٍ. وَفيها تَمارينُ مُطابَقَةٍ لِأَعْضاءِ الجِسْمِ.

intro.en: Practise asking and answering in pairs. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني.» Also «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ إلى…؟» (why did you come to…?) and «هَلْ لَدَيْكَ مَوْعِدٌ مَعَ…؟».
intro.ur: Dost ke saath sawal jawab ki mashq karein. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني.» Phir «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ إلى…؟» (aap kyun aaye?) aur «هَلْ لَدَيْكَ مَوْعِدٌ مَعَ…؟» (kya aap ka waqt hai?).
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ: «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ شَديدٍ في أُذُني.» وَكَذَلِكَ «لِماذا حَضَرْتَ إِلى…؟» وَ«هَلْ لَدَيْكَ مَوْعِدٌ مَعَ…؟».

options: I came to meet the dentist / Main daanton ke doctor se milne aaya
I went home / Main ghar gaya
I felt a pain in my nose / Meri naak mein dard hai
I eat fruit / Main phal khata hoon
Do you have an appointment? / Kya aap ka waqt liya hua hai?
Where is the doctor? / Doctor kahan hai?
What is your name? / Aap ka naam kya hai?
How old are you? / Aap ki umar kya hai?
options_ar: عَمّا إِذا كانَ عِنْدَهُ وَقْتٌ مَحْجوزٌ

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «kyun» ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ السَّبَبِ؟

q.en: Which sentence says «my appointment is at the ninth hour»?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla kehta hai «mera waqt nau baje hai»?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَقولُ إِنَّ المَوْعِدَ في السّاعَةِ التّاسِعَةِ؟

intro.en: Listen and repeat the long «ـُ / و» sound (as in مَحْمود and ثَلاثون). Then listen to a short story about Ahmad and Ammar and answer the questions.
intro.ur: Suniye aur dohraiye: lambi «ـُ / و» ki awaaz (jaise مَحْمود aur ثَلاثون mein). Phir Ahmad aur Ammar ki chhoti kahani sun kar sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرْ صَوْتَ الواوِ الطَّويلَةِ بَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ كَما في مَحْمود وَثَلاثون. ثُمَّ اسْتَمِعْ إِلى قِصَّةٍ قَصيرَةٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ وَعَمّارٍ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

q.en: Which word has the long «و» sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi «و» ki awaaz hai?

q.en: Which word has the long «و» sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi «و» ki awaaz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ أُخْرى فيها واوُ مَدٍّ؟

options: What did Ahmad feel? / Ahmad ne kya mehsoos kiya?
Where did Ahmad go? / Ahmad kahan gaya?
Who is Ahmad? / Ahmad kaun hai?
When did Ahmad eat? / Ahmad ne kab khaya?
How are Ahmad's teeth? / Ahmad ke daant kaise hain?
How old is Ahmad? / Ahmad ki umar kya hai?
Where is Ahmad? / Ahmad kahan hai?
What is Ahmad's name? / Ahmad ka naam kya hai?

intro.en: Talk with a friend using the pictures. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في صَدْري. وَبِمَ تَشْعُرُ أَنْتَ؟» Also «هَلْ قابَلْتَ الطَّبيب؟» – «نَعَم، وَفَحَصَ القَلْب.»
intro.ur: Tasweeron ki madad se dost ke saath baat karein. «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في صَدْري. وَبِمَ تَشْعُرُ أَنْتَ؟» Aur «هَلْ قابَلْتَ الطَّبيب؟» – «نَعَم، وَفَحَصَ القَلْب.»
intro.ar: تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ صَديقِكَ مُسْتَعيناً بِالصُّوَرِ: «بِمَ تَشْعُرُ؟» – «أَشْعُرُ بِأَلَمٍ في صَدْري. وَبِمَ تَشْعُرُ أَنْتَ؟» وَكَذَلِكَ «هَلْ قابَلْتَ الطَّبيبَ؟» – «نَعَمْ، وَفَحَصَ القَلْبَ.»

q.en: How do you say «I feel pain in my chest»?
q.ur: «Mere seene mein dard hai» Arabi mein kaise kahenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَقولُها إِذا كانَ الأَلَمُ في صَدْرِكَ؟
قيلَ: «ما النَّتيجَةُ؟» – «القَلْبُ سَليمٌ». ما السَّليمُ هُنا؟

options: What does Badr eat? / Badr kya khata hai?
Where is Badr? / Badr kahan hai?
How is Badr? / Badr kaisa hai?
What does Badr feel? / Badr ko kya mehsoos hota hai?

intro.en: Read short texts about people who go to the doctor: Ahmad has a heart check, Kawthar has a headache and fever, and a grandfather who is eighty years old stays healthy.
intro.ur: Un logon ke bare mein chhote matn parhiye jo doctor ke paas jaate hain: Ahmad ke dil ka muaina, Kauthar ko sar dard aur bukhar, aur assi saal ke dada jo sehatmand hain.
intro.ar: اِقْرَأْ نُصوصًا قَصيرَةً عَمَّنْ يَذْهَبونَ إِلى الطَّبيبِ: أَحْمَدُ يَفْحَصُ قَلْبَهُ، وَكَوْثَرُ تَشْكو مِنْ صُداعٍ وَحُمّى، وَجَدٌّ عُمْرُهُ ثَمانونَ سَنَةً وَما زالَ بِصِحَّةٍ جَيِّدَةٍ.

q.ur: Ahmad ka waqt kab ka hai?

q.en: What did the doctor advise Ahmad?
q.ur: Doctor ne Ahmad ko kya naseehat ki?

q.en: Kawthar went to the ear doctor. What did she feel?
q.ur: Kauthar kaan ke doctor ke paas gayi. Usay kya mehsoos hua?
q.ar: ذَهَبَتْ كَوْثَرُ إِلى طَبيبِ الأُذُنِ. بِمَ شَعَرَتْ؟

intro.en: Match words, arrange words into sentences, fill the gaps, and write health words such as زُكام (cold), أُذُن (ear) and تَقْرير (report) letter by letter.
intro.ur: Lafzon ko milaiye, lafzon ko jumle mein tarteeb dein, khaali jagah bharein, aur sehat ke alfaaz jaise زُكام (zukam), أُذُن (kaan) aur تَقْرير (report) harf ba harf likhein.
intro.ar: طابِقِ الكَلِماتِ، وَرَتِّبْها لِتُكَوِّنَ جُمَلًا، وَأَكْمِلِ الفَراغاتِ، وَاكْتُبْ كَلِماتِ الصِّحَّةِ مِثْلَ زُكام وَأُذُن وَتَقْرير حَرْفًا حَرْفًا.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «report» ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني وَرَقَةً يَكْتُبُ فيها الطَّبيبُ نَتيجَةَ الفَحْصِ؟

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «waqt (appointment)» ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني الوَقْتَ المُحَدَّدَ لِلِقاءِ الطَّبيبِ؟

options: May Allah heal you / Allah aap ko shifa de
